evidence.observation: System pressure dropped abruptly from ~500 mbar to ~255 mbar between k=10 and k=13, then partially recovered and settled near 300 mbar, not the original 500 mbar setpoint.
Transient spike to 18.6 mbar at k=10 then settling to ~0 / slightly negative, versus steady 0.6 mbar before — differential pressure baseline shifted.
Reboiler temperature fell 443→323 °C then climbed back to 426 °C, indicating a large process upset rather than sensor noise.
Top-section temperatures dropped from 63.3 to ~52.5 °C consistent with lower operating pressure; column re-equilibrating at a new operating point.

args.missing_evidence: Vacuum/pressure-control setpoint and valve status, plus a distillate composition sample; a leak-check or pressure hold test would distinguish a seal leak from a deliberate pressure change.
